summary: When source and destination have different ordering or storage types, clone_from_bitslice incorrectly reads the destination's own bits, leaving it unchanged. The fix reads from src instead. The existing vec::tests::misc test, updated by this commit, appends five Msb0/u16 one-bits to five Lsb0/u8 zero-bits. Reversing the fix leaves all ten destination bits zero, violating its equality assertion. This plan is based on source inspection; no tests were run.
